title: Aggregation-level and ecological-inference barrier for thermo-psyche analogies
hypothesis: A level-of-analysis contract can reject individual-from-group, group-from-individual, and reversal-prone inferences unless an explicit validated bridge is present, preventing aggregated psyche labels from being equated with thermodynamic ensemble variables.
null_or_failure: Group correlation becomes an individual claim, individual association becomes a population law, a Simpson reversal is hidden, aggregation weights are absent, levels are mixed inside one equation, or a labeled analogy becomes a fundamental thermo-psyche law or consciousness claim.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate analysis level, aggregation weights, subgroup composition, reversal direction, scale type, thermodynamic domain, causal wording, and fundamental-law flags; reject every unbridged cross-level or cross-category inference.
rollback_or_recovery: Restore the least committal level-specific description, retain the reversal or inference counterexample, remove cross-level equations, and require real construct and bridge validation before any stronger claim.
boundary: Level-of-analysis checks preserve analogy boundaries and do not establish a thermo-psyche law, consciousness, or personhood.
